name: message
need: Show one turn of a conversation: user, assistant, system or tool, streaming, stopped or failed, with copy, retry, edit and feedback

--ds-message-avatar-size.description: the round avatar slot at md (8px per size step)

--ds-message-gap.description: the room between a message's head, content, note and footer (2px less per density step)

--ds-message-user-bg.description: the bubble of the user's own message

--ds-message-user-color.description: the text in the user's bubble

--ds-message-user-max.description: the widest the user's bubble grows, of the message's width

--ds-message-radius.description: the user's bubble (the tool frame takes half), times `--ds-shape`

--ds-message-tool-bg.description: the frame of a tool result

labExempt.DS.message.create: states and events: the text that streams in is the motion; the copy swap is .ds-icon-swap's (button)
